issue_context.title: document server-side dry run is GA
issue_context.body:
<!-- Please only use this template for submitting enhancement requests -->

**What would you like to be added**:

Server-side dry-run is being promoted from beta to GA in v1.18.

For the server-side dry-run integration in kubectl, we are making a few changes:

- we're extending the `--dry-run` flag to support the options `client`, `server` and `none`
- we're deprecating no value for the `--dry-run` flag, such that setting a value will be required in the future
- we're deprecating the boolean values for the `--dry-run` flag and will remove these values in the future
- we're deprecating the `kubectl apply` `--server-dry-run` flag

We need to document these changes accordingly on the website and in comments and tests.

Documentation includes:

- [x] document server-side dry-run feature state as stable for v1.18 (update Hugo shortcode) https://github.com/kubernetes/website/pull/19549
- [x] dry-run auth requirements @julianvmodesto https://github.com/kubernetes/website/pull/18235
- [ ] document all API requests, including server-side dry-run, are single-resource requests https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/83562 https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/86026 https://github.com/kubernetes/website/pull/19550
- [x] deprecation notices for `--dry-run`: covered by release notes
- [x] deprecation notice for `--server-dry-run`: covered by release notes
- [x] all usage and examples on the website https://github.com/kubernetes/website/pull/19549
- [x] all usage in code comments and tests

**Why is this needed**:

Server-side dry-run is graduating to GA, so we need to document usage and examples for users for how to use the feature.

Because we're extending an existing flag and deprecating aspects of this existing feature, we need to have consistent documentation for the flag that reflects the changes.

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/85652
GA umbrella issue: https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/issues/68514
KEP: https://github.com/kubernetes/enhancements/blob/master/keps/sig-api-machinery/0015-dry-run.md

cc @apelisse 
/sig cli
/sig api-machinery
/priority important-soon
/help
